profile.headline: Computer Engineering | Computer Systems Engineering | Software Engineer Manager | Solutions Architect | Chileno
profile.summary:
My journey with technology began at an early age when I first start using computers at around 10 years old. This early passion for computing(hardware and software) has evolved into a deep expertise in programming, system architecture, and embedded systems. I have more than 15 years of professional experience, and more 5 years leading/managing teams of engineers. I have worked in a vast variety of projects related to the mining industry,  delivering high-value solutions and over the past few years, I have been working in migrating on-prem applications to the cloud.
I enjoy working as a team member as well as independently. I have strong interpersonal skills, positive work ethic, compromise, meet deadlines, good communication with stakeholders and peers, time management and organization skills, I learn quickly and adapt to emerging technologies. 
Experience in Agile methodology and advance programming skills in C, C++, C# and python, also familiar Fortran, VB, Java, PHP, HTML, React, JS SQL query and a variety of SDK's.

projects.title: Customer Enablement Team Lead
projects.description: Lead and coordinate a cross-functional team of engineers to drive the execution of development work during customer engagements. This includes crafting iterative features based on customer inputs, integrating with external systems and optimizing algorithms for the Vestrex platform with a string "cloud-first" strategy. The primary objective is to ensure seamless onboarding and build customer trust, enabling platform teams to remain focused on core development without being distracted by engagement-specific requirements, and vice versa.

projects.title: Vulcan Product
projects.description: Vulcan is a comprehensive and advanced 3D geological modeling and mine planning software used primarily in the mining industry. It allows users to visualize, model, and manage geospatial data, helping geologists, engineers, and mine planners make better decisions regarding exploration, resource modeling, mine design, and production scheduling.

organizations.name: Regalos de Esperanza
organizations.position: Coordinador de equipo de Recreación · Apr 2012 - Present
organizations.description: Organización 100% sin fines de lucro y fue creada con el fin de sacar una sonrisa a los niños afectados por el terremoto del 27 de febrero del 2010 en el sur de Chile, Después de superado este acontecimiento, hoy, la organización recorre las distintas poblaciones de la V Región con situación de pobreza, para entregarles un momento de felicidad a los niños de mayor vulnerabilidad al riesgo social.
